appearance_facts.fact: The main title reads 'Reduced Screening Referrals Across Hospitals from 2012 to 2023' and the subtitle reads 'Referral-monitoring record shown in the dashboard summary'. This text is located in the upper-left portion of the image.
A single, solid orange line graph is plotted, showing a general upward trend from left to right over the years 2012 to 2023.

The line starts at a value of approximately 1,100 in 2012, fluctuates, and reaches its peak in 2022 at a value of approximately 3,600. It then shows a slight decrease in 2023 to a value of approximately 3,300.
The y-axis is labeled 'Screening referrals' and has numerical tick marks at 0, 800, 1600, 2400, and 3200. Faint horizontal gridlines extend from these ticks across the plot area.
The x-axis is labeled 'Year' and has tick marks for each year from 2012 to 2023.
The visual pattern of the data line is one of significant growth, increasing from a low starting point to a much higher peak, despite the title's wording.

public_definitions: The user's goal is to 'Review the screening referral dashboard and assign this record to the operational follow-up pathway that best fits the referral pattern over the reporting period.'
The available options are: 'Route to growth-focused referral follow-up', 'Route to reduction-focused referral follow-up', and 'Route to standard referral monitoring'.
